en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Salih Bin Saeed, from Yunus, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man who was fierce upon his woman, or a woman who was fierce upon her husband, so one of the them killed the other one. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is nothing upon both of them, when they were two trustworthy ones. So if they are brought, the swearing of oath by Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would be necessitated upon them both that they did not intend the killing’.
